text:
Marie Lefevre: Quick doc question — ran the link scanner and found an orphaned image on /guides/model-onboarding. Image returns 403 and alt text is empty. Anyone owning that page? Want a small PR to fix alt text and rehost the image.
Sam Patel: cc @Alex — I think marketing touched that guide last quarter.
Alex Gomez: I updated copy but didn’t touch images. I can take a look. Can you paste the failing URL?
Marie Lefevre: `https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/guides/onnboard-hero.png` — scanner flagged 403. Also alt="" in the markdown.
Jia Liu: I can do a quick replace if we re-upload to S3. Sam/Marie — any preferred alt text?
Sam Patel: Suggestion: 'Model onboarding flow diagram' — maybe be more descriptive: 'diagram showing model onboarding stages: upload, validate, deploy'
Alex Gomez: :thumbsup: that reads better. Jia — if you make a PR, add a frontmatter owner and ping @docs-bot for cache flush.
Jia Liu: On it. Will re-upload to the s3 bucket and open a PR. PR will include the sed I used to update alt text locally:
```bash
# replace empty alt with new alt text in markdown files
sed -n 's/!\[\s*\]\((.*)\)/![Model onboarding flow diagram](\1)/p' -i docs/guides/model-onboarding.md
```
Jia Liu: (also gzipping the image before upload to match our CDN policy)
pr-bot: PR opened: #1289 — jia/upload-rehost-onnboard-hero — https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1289
Marie Lefevre: Nice, thanks. Can someone claim ownership of the guide in frontmatter? We should avoid future orphaning.
Alex Gomez: I'll add `owner: "alex.gomez@redwood.ai"` to frontmatter in the PR.
docs-bot: Reminder — after merge, run `yarn docs:deploy --flush-cache` or request a cache flush ticket so the new asset becomes available.
Sam Patel: Thanks all. Small FYI: I saw an extra dead anchor on that page too, I'll add it to the PR comments so it can be fixed in the same change.
Marie Lefevre: Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround :rocket:
